summary: Phase 1 review of AutoAds Network public marketing site + Website Leads CRM + branding + regressions. Wrote /app/backend/tests/test_public_site.py (45 cases). 44/45 pass. One real bug: /robots.txt is served from the static file /app/laravel/public/robots.txt ('User-agent: *\nDisallow:\n') which SHADOWS the Laravel route PublicController::robots() (that route would emit a proper Sitemap: reference and Allow/Disallow rules). All 16 public pages render 200 with no error markers; sitemap.xml is valid XML with <urlset>/<loc>; home has the correct hero copy, animated stat counters (Active Autos 42, Screens Online 0, Coverage Cities 2, Active Campaigns 7), header CTA data-testid header-start-advertising-btn correctly links to /contact?type=advertiser; mobile hamburger open/close works (390x844); /network shows live stat cards + coverage; /pricing shows all 4 plans (Starter/Growth/City Domination/Enterprise); /faq renders accordion items with data-testid faq-<id>. Contact form POST creates a Lead (status='new'), redirects with green success flash data-testid site-flash-success; lead surfaces in /leads inbox; PUT /leads/{id} persists status change to 'contacted'; admin notification 'New Website Enquiry' is created and appears in /notifications and the bell dropdown. Branding settings tab renders logo upload input (data-testid set-logo) + save button (data-testid save-settings) + brand_name/tagline inputs, and PUT /settings/branding persists a new tagline. All 4 portal logins still redirect to their portals; admin routes /dashboard /autos /devices /campaigns /settlements /users /leads all 200 clean; sidebar shows 'Website Leads' link + AutoAds brand; /api/docs gated for guests (302/401/403); advertiser API login works and /api/v1/owners returns 403 for advertiser scope.

minor.issue: Response is the default Laravel static file '/app/laravel/public/robots.txt' ('User-agent: *\nDisallow:\n'), which shadows the well-formed route PublicController::robots(). The route would emit 'User-agent: * / Allow: / / Disallow: /dashboard /settings /api/ / Sitemap: <abs URL>' but is never reached because Nginx/PHP serves the static file first. Fix: delete /app/laravel/public/robots.txt so the route is used. Low but real SEO impact — the site's own Sitemap reference is missing.

ui_bugs.issue: Console warns 'Alpine Warning: You can\'t use [x-collapse] without first installing the Collapse plugin.' on /faq and any page using x-collapse (FAQ accordion). The accordion click toggles state but the smooth collapse animation is not applied. Fix: include Alpine collapse plugin via CDN e.g. <script defer src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@alpinejs/collapse@3.x.x/dist/cdn.min.js"></script> before Alpine core.

Lucide reports 'twitter/linkedin/facebook/instagram icon name was not found in the provided icons object.' Newer Lucide renamed twitter->twitter-x. Icons render as empty <i> tags — footer social links have no visible glyph. Fix: use current lucide names (e.g. 'twitter' -> 'twitter' works in older versions; upgrade Lucide or switch to inline SVGs; check pinned CDN version).

issues: Tailwind CSS is still loaded from cdn.tailwindcss.com. Every page prints 'cdn.tailwindcss.com should not be used in production' — carried over from iteration_2. Move to a Vite/CLI build.

Install Alpine.js Collapse plugin so [x-collapse] works (FAQ accordion animations).

rca_of_the_issue: robots.txt SEO bug — Nginx/PHP-FPM in Laravel's public/ directory serves static files before hitting index.php's router. The stock Laravel install ships with a placeholder public/robots.txt containing only 'User-agent: *\nDisallow:\n'. The Phase 1 feature added a Route::get('/robots.txt', PublicController::robots) that constructs a proper robots response including Sitemap: <abs URL>, Allow/Disallow rules for /dashboard, /settings, /api/. Because the static file is present in public/, it always wins and the route never runs. Fix: `rm /app/laravel/public/robots.txt` (and optionally clear route cache). Reproduce: `curl https://<host>/robots.txt` returns 2 lines; after removing the static file it should return the full route body.
